briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Claim the Cauldron Memory Grove: Lore Price. Enter Cauldron Memory Grove on Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate while the Gate remains Sealed Gate with fae time bleed. Reference deity voice is Lugh, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, open the relic detour in the Cauldron Memory Grove, secure the hidden memory, and take the reward without awakening the wrong memory.

missionIntro.speaker: Lugh Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A geas is a road that remembers the foot that broke it. The Cauldron Memory Grove will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the treasure or lore pressure of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: fae time pools that age or reverse cooldowns

victory.speaker: Lugh Divine Voice
victory.text: The root remembers obedience and opens one more ring.

defeat.speaker: Lugh Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Silver-Root Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Avalora is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Cauldron Memory Grove as part of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Cauldron Memory Grove as a treasure or lore node in Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth; silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
